final_draft.answer: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer word for word (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-17). A live check of AWS account 111122223333 on 2026-11-17 at 01:05 UTC agrees with it: all four S3 public access block settings were on. Both sources cover only that one account. If the company keeps S3 buckets in any other AWS account, neither source says whether public access is blocked there.
